cases.refreshed: Every now and then, libraries need a little extra love from the communities they serve. You can volunteer away your library fines at a rate of $20 per hour while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment. Volunteers will be responsible for: Book cover cleaning – Use disinfecting wipes to reinvigorate dingy books. Bookshelves – Dust shelves and organize library materials. Deep cleaning computers – Use disinfecting wipes to disinfect computer mice and mouse pads and compressed air to remove any dust particles or debris. Material inspection – Check books for torn pages, pen marks, etc. This is a perfect opportunity for families interested in volunteering away their library fines. Volunteers must commit to the full session. The library asks that only families volunteer at this event. Anyone under 15 must volunteer with a parent or guardian. No experience or special skills are needed. Training and supplies will be provided. To register, please call 408-808-2196 or email evan.rabinowitz@sjlibrary.org, to allow us to plan for your visit.
